Part 2B - Currency Information
2B.1 Does the entity default to payment in certain currencies dependent upon certain attributes such as the
banking instruction or registered address of the +securityholder? (For example NZD to residents of New Zealand
and/or USD to residents of the U.S.A.).
2B.2 Please provide a description of your currency arrangements
Dividend will be paid in AUD unless shareholders are:
a. Domiciled in NZ and have provided a NZD bank account in which case dividend will be paid in NZD
b. Domiciled in NZ and have not provided a NZD bank account or an AUD bank account in which case payment will be
withheld until bank account details are provided
